title: Relaxing Retreat/Private Rm/Bath
description:
Historic Franklin, TN.   Close to historic tourist sites:  Carnton Plantation, 
downtown Franklin,  Franklin Civil War Battlefield.  Nashville just 30 minutes. Private room/bath in private home set in wooded subdivision 5 miles from Franklin.  Note:  30 min to Nashville. *No food in bedroom.  May eat in sunroom.  Leave shoes inside front door.  * Uber unreliable here.  Adults only 2.  Min. in 2 day bookings.

The space
We live in the home.  The Airbnb rental is for a private room with en-suite bath upstairs.  Large bedroom with work station and chair.  Coffeemaker.  Dining available in sunroom downstairs.

Guest access
Access to  wifi, coffee maker.  *May eat in sunroom, not bedroom.

During your stay
Upon arrival, as needed, and in common areas such as back deck or shared sunroom downstairs.

Other things to note
Historic sites include Battlefield of Franklin, Civil War era.  Carter House and Carnton Plantation.  Lots of shops and historic theatre downtown.  Shopping downtown and Cool Springs Mall.  Lots of varied restaurants. 
*Leave shoes inside front door, please.  No food in bedroom.  May eat in our sunroom.
